INSERT INTO content_feedback (
            organization_id,
            content_id,
            content_type,
            user_id,
            reaction
         )
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
         ON CONFLICT (organization_id, user_id, content_id, content_type)
         DO UPDATE
             SET reaction = EXCLUDED.reaction,
                 updated_at = now()
